sql: with s as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, raw_json->>'settled_time' st, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) q, raw_json->>'fees_paid_dollars' fees, raw_json->>'total_traded_dollars' traded from positions where raw_json ? 'settled_time' and market_ticker in (select distinct o.market_ticker from live_orders o where o.strategy='Alimm1') order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), f as (select distinct on (f.id) f.market_ticker, o.action oa, f.action fa, f.side, f.price, f.quantity from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1') select s.market_ticker, s.realized_pnl, s.fees, s.traded, string_agg(f.oa||'/'||coalesce(f.fa,'?')||'/'||f.side||'@'||f.price||'x'||f.quantity, ' ' order by f.oa) fills from s left join f using (market_ticker) group by 1,2,3,4 order by 1
